tools.why: Enables moving deleted files to the desktop trash (with undo) on Linux instead of a permanent delete. gio (from GNOME/glib2) is tried first and usually already present; trash-put (trash-cli) is the fallback worth installing on a minimal/non-GNOME setup.

Powers the fast in-directory grep search feature and pre-filters the reference scan that keeps links and imports pointing at the right file after a rename or move. Without it, grep-in-dir is unavailable and the reference scan falls back to a capped directory walk (slower, same result).
